title: Confeti
tagline: Confeti enables simple & seamless crypto trades for all. Built for tomorrow’s digital economy.
description: Confeti is the central hub for seamless token trading across multiple blockchain networks. Powered by blockchain technology, it empowers users to trade tokens effortlessly while staying fully informed about their profits and transaction history. By abstracting away the complexity of cross-chain transactions, Confeti delivers a smooth, intuitive experience that feels as familiar as any web2 app.
how_its_made:
Confeti is powered by 1inch and Cruvegrid. 1inch Fusion+ handles cross-chain swaps, abstracting the complexity away from the user. Their API is also used to fetch token info.

Cruvegrid BaaS indexes the user's cross-chain swap history without requiring custom code in our backend.

Embedded wallets make the experience seamless—no private keys to manage or lose. The frontend is built with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, and Ethers.js. The live version is deployed on Vercel.
